name: 相关_AI_zh
text: 上周去超市买了水果和牛奶，顺便逛了逛书店。人工智能正在改变我们的生活，机器学习、深度学习等技术在医疗、金融等领域广泛应用。大模型在写作、编程、翻译等场景越来越实用。下午回家路上遇到邻居遛狗，聊了几句。晚上看了新闻，感觉科技发展真快，AI监管和伦理议题也频频出现。

name: 相关_AI_en
text: Last week I bought fruit and milk at the supermarket and browsed a bookstore. Artificial intelligence is changing our lives; machine learning and deep learning are widely used in healthcare, finance, and more. Large models are increasingly practical for writing, coding, and translation. On the way home I met a neighbor walking a dog and chatted briefly. In the evening news I felt technology was advancing fast, and AI regulation and ethics topics kept coming up.

name: 相关_天气_zh
text: 早上起来先做了半小时瑜伽，然后吃了早餐。今天北京天气晴朗，气温适宜，最高约18度，适合户外活动。明天可能有小雨，记得带伞。下午约了朋友喝咖啡，聊了聊最近的工作计划。傍晚回家路上顺便买了菜，本周整体以晴到多云为主，周末可能有轻度霾。

name: 相关_天气_en
text: I woke up, did half an hour of yoga, then had breakfast. Today's weather in Beijing is sunny and mild, with a high around 18°C—good for outdoor activities. There may be light rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella. In the afternoon I met a friend for coffee and talked about work plans. On the way home I bought groceries; the week is mostly sunny to cloudy, with possible light haze over the weekend.

name: 相关_医疗_zh
text: 周末去爬山锻炼身体，山上的风景不错。人工智能在医疗领域的应用越来越广泛，比如辅助诊断、药物研发、智能问诊等。机器学习能帮助医生更快分析影像资料，减少漏诊。远程医疗、健康管理APP也借助AI提升体验。下山后去吃了碗面，味道一般。

name: 相关_医疗_en
text: Over the weekend I hiked for exercise; the mountain views were nice. Artificial intelligence is increasingly used in healthcare—for assisted diagnosis, drug discovery, and smart consultation. Machine learning helps doctors analyze imaging faster and reduce missed diagnoses. Telemedicine and health apps also use AI to improve the experience. After hiking I had a bowl of noodles; it was average.

name: 无关_足球对AI_zh
text: 人工智能正在改变我们的生活。机器学习、深度学习等技术在医疗、金融等领域广泛应用。大模型在自然语言处理上表现突出，自动驾驶也在稳步推进。智能客服、推荐系统、内容生成等应用已司空见惯。未来几年AI将渗透到更多行业，带来深刻变革。

name: 无关_足球对AI_en
text: Artificial intelligence is changing our lives. Machine learning and deep learning are widely used in healthcare, finance, and more. Large models excel at natural language processing, and autonomous driving is advancing steadily. Smart customer service, recommendation systems, and content generation are already common. In the coming years AI will permeate more industries and bring deep change.

name: 无关_烹饪对天气_zh
text: 今天北京天气晴朗，气温适宜，适合户外活动。明天可能有小雨，记得带伞。本周以晴到多云为主，周末可能有轻度霾。春季早晚温差大，建议洋葱式穿衣。周末可以去公园散步，或者在家看书，最近空气质量不错，适合开窗通风。

name: 无关_烹饪对天气_en
text: Today's weather in Beijing is sunny and mild, good for outdoor activities. There may be light rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella. The week is mostly sunny to cloudy, with possible light haze over the weekend. Spring mornings and evenings have large temperature swings; dress in layers. You can walk in the park or read at home; air quality has been good lately, so open the windows.

name: 人工智能_zh
text:
【华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年2月12日】标普500指数基本持平，纳指和道指小幅下跌；原油期货上涨；黄金、白银走高；镍价升至近两周来最高，主要供应国印尼暗示今年将大幅削减产量。
美国1月非农新增就业13万人，创去年4月以来最大增幅，失业率降至4.3%，年度下修86.2万。华尔街预计首次降息延至7月，“新美联储通讯社”预计降息暂停期更久。
油价日内涨超2%，报道：特朗普私下考虑退出《美墨加协定》。
特朗普称同伊朗达成协议将是“首选”，伊朗最高领袖顾问：美国趋向理性。
李强：全面推进人工智能科技创新、产业发展和赋能应用，培育壮大新质生产力。
国务院国资委推动中央企业积极扩大算力有效投资。
中国1月CPI同比涨幅回落至0.2%，PPI同比降幅收窄至1.4%。
载人登月又一里程碑，长征十号与梦舟飞船首次飞行试验任务成功。
DeepSeek正灰度测试新一代模型。
智谱发布新一代旗舰模型GLM-5，重点提升编程与智能体能力。
苹果新Siri发布或又推迟，据称测试暴露问题，部分功能或延至9月上线。 （来自华尔街见闻）

name: 人工智能_en
text:
[Wall Street Breakfast | Feb 12, 2026] The S&P 500 was roughly flat; the Nasdaq and Dow edged lower. Crude oil futures rose; gold and silver moved higher. Nickel hit a near-two-week high as major supplier Indonesia hinted at sharp production cuts this year.
US January nonfarm payrolls rose by 130,000, the largest gain since April last year; unemployment fell to 4.3%, with an annual revision down 862,000. Wall Street expects the first rate cut delayed to July; the “Fed whisperer” sees a longer pause.
Oil jumped over 2% intraday; reports say Trump privately considered exiting USMCA.
Trump said a deal with Iran would be the “preferred” outcome; an adviser to Iran’s Supreme Leader said the US was trending toward rationality.
Li Qiang: fully advance AI science and technology innovation, industrial development, and enabling applications to grow new quality productive forces.
SASAC urged central SOEs to expand effective computing-power investment.
China’s January CPI YoY eased to 0.2%; PPI YoY decline narrowed to 1.4%.
Another crewed lunar milestone: Long March 10 and Mengzhou spacecraft completed their first flight tests.
DeepSeek is A/B-testing a next-generation model.
Zhipu released flagship GLM-5, focusing on coding and agent capabilities.
Apple’s new Siri may slip again; testing reportedly exposed issues, with some features delayed to September. (via Wall Street CN)

name: 北京美食_zh
text:
北京烤鸭是北京最著名的特色美食，皮酥肉嫩，配上薄饼和甜面酱。
故宫是明清两代的皇家宫殿，也是世界上现存规模最大的木质结构古建筑群。
炸酱面是北京的传统面食，用黄酱配上黄瓜丝和豆芽菜。
长城是中国古代的军事防御工程，绵延数千公里。
老北京涮羊肉以铜锅为特色，羊肉鲜嫩，蘸料丰富。
天坛是明清两代皇帝祭天的场所，建筑精美。
豆汁儿是北京独特的传统小吃，口味特别，配上焦圈最地道。
颐和园是清朝的皇家园林，以昆明湖和万寿山为主体。
南京鸭血粉丝汤是南京最著名的特色美食。
但是南京的盐水鸭就不好吃了。不喜欢它的颜色和味道。
苏州的美食臊子面也挺好吃的。

name: 北京美食_en
text:
Peking duck is Beijing’s most famous specialty—crispy skin, tender meat, with thin pancakes and sweet bean sauce.
The Forbidden City was the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties and remains the world’s largest surviving wooden palace complex.
Zhajiangmian is a traditional Beijing noodle dish with yellow bean paste, cucumber, and bean sprouts.
The Great Wall is an ancient Chinese military defense project stretching thousands of kilometers.
Old Beijing hotpot features a copper pot, tender lamb, and rich dipping sauces.
The Temple of Heaven is where Ming and Qing emperors offered sacrifices to heaven; the architecture is exquisite.
Douzhir is a unique traditional Beijing snack with a distinctive taste, best with fried dough rings.
The Summer Palace is a Qing imperial garden centered on Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill.
Nanjing duck-blood vermicelli soup is Nanjing’s most famous specialty.
But Nanjing salted duck is not good—I dislike its color and taste.
Suzhou’s saozi noodles are also quite tasty.
